boosters.name: Art Peek
boosters.description: Shows the finished painting for 3 seconds.

boosters.name: Hint Lens
boosters.description: Shows the best move on the shelf.

boosters.name: Time Freeze
boosters.description: For 5 seconds your moves are free. Move as fast as you can!

boosters.name: Magic Hand
boosters.description: Tap the shelf: the free books in that area go into place (2x2, or 3x2 on Super Hard levels). No move spent.

boosters.name: Art Brush
boosters.description: Pick a shelf: the whole shelf gets painted into place. No moves spent.
